name: Slack for Charities
summary: Slack's charity programme has published benefits but explicitly excludes churches and religious organisations.

benefits.label: Slack charity programme
benefits.value: Free Pro upgrade or discounted plans for qualifying organisations

churchEligibility.summary: Slack explicitly excludes a church, association of churches or other religious organisation from this charity programme.

ukAvailability.summary: Slack publishes this help article for UK readers.

caveats: Slack's ordinary free plan remains available on normal terms.
